user.title: Connect EKF appliances
user.description: Create controls for the Haier air conditioner and Toshiba projector using an existing EKF remote. Optionally select a Samsung TV.

data_description.projector_on_script: Leave empty to use the existing Projector turn on script.

data_description.tv_entity_id: Select a TV from the Samsung Smart TV integration. Leave empty if you do not want to add TV controls.
